question: A train covers 180 km in 3 hours. How long will it take to cover 240 km at the same speed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed same ⇒ Time ∝ Distance

⇒ 180 km ⇒ 3 hr

⇒ 240 km ⇒ (240 ÷ 180) × 3

⇒ = (4 ÷ 3) × 3 = 4 hr

**∴ Answer = 4 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance = 180 km, Time = 3 hours

New distance = 240 km

**Formula:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed = 180 ÷ 3 = 60 km/hr

⇒ Time for 240 km = 240 ÷ 60 = 4 hours

**∴ Required time = 4 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Speed Formula:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Direct Proportion:** If speed is constant, Time ∝ Distance

**Unit Conversion:** Ensure km/hr consistency while calculating

**Shortcut Tip:** Use ratio method to avoid full speed calculation
